review.notes: Clean document, no patches. No code fences in the OCR, so no fence-swallowing. All four physical PDF pages were compared line-by-line against the OCR Markdown with a normalized word diff (case/punctuation-insensitive); the only divergences are page furniture the reader intentionally drops (the cover-page standalone 'July 2026', which survives in the body as 'Published: July 2026', and the trailing folio numerals 1/2/3). No dropped sentences, prompt boxes, tables, footnote bodies or references exist in this model card. Bullet glyphs print as filled circles and the OCR mixes '\-' escapes with literal '•' markers; following the repo's established handling of model-card bullet style (sibling cards normalized both directions), markers were left exactly as OCR produced them.
